gaps.explanation: p6 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds prints General, Street and Keno Fund columns; detail has only the General Fund (p13 departments, 1,787,327.05 = p6 General). The p12 all-funds budget schedule mixes the funds, so Street and Keno have no schedule of their own. Street: Motor vehicle 5,389.43 + Intergovernmental 58,773.03 + Insurance proceeds 82,513.13 = 146,675.59; Keno Fund: Investment income 252.85. 1,787,327.05 + 146,675.59 + 252.85 = 1,934,255.49 = statement total.

gaps.explanation: Detail holds the p12 all-funds budget schedule's budgetary-basis actuals per utility (Electric 513,888.26, Water 173,000.63, Sewer 44,267.95, Solid Waste 182,275.63 = 913,432.47). The statement total is the p9 proprietary statement: Cost of purchased power 291,665.70 + Total operating expenses 591,564.63 (incl. Depreciation 137,627.00) + Interest expense 16,899.02 = 900,129.35. Per fund, p9 vs p12: Electric 495,751.49 vs 513,888.26 (+18,136.77), Water 168,581.08 vs 173,000.63 (+4,419.55), Sewer 37,913.43 vs 44,267.95 (+6,354.52), Waste 197,883.35 vs 182,275.63 (-15,607.72); net +13,303.12 = schedule above statement. The budget basis excludes depreciation and includes capital purchases and debt principal, so the printed totals really differ. No fix.
